scope: Native Protocol B current-frame feature production for all six outer videos, two fit-only visible-token objectives and three seeds; unchanged FIFO current-identity replay and scoped official TrackEval. This is not a raw end-to-end FPS measurement and does not itself establish a contribution.

paired_native_global_fifo_reference.scope_note: Reference rows use the pre-existing native global FIFO control with the same registered proposals/lifecycle but a different frozen feature source; deltas are descriptive paired controls, not a claim of exact encoder parity.

runtime_scope.note: Replay excludes decode, RGB/pseudo-IR transform, detector, crop and encoder; use the separately measured strict-raw report for whole-pipeline timing.

interpretation.claim_boundary: Allfold native evidence is measured and paired against the visible-target objective and descriptive native global FIFO reference. A positive final architecture or mechanical combination is not claimed without stable independent benefit across folds/seeds and matched controls.
